vb_textbox.text: os My advice to any new player would be to make sure you find a quiet room, where there is no interruptions or television.  Ensure that you are comfortable with your keyboard and know where the S and K keys are as well as the spacebar.  Position your fingers on the keys and be in a comfortable calm mindset.  When the game starts the best way to rack up points without failing was to continually hit the the keys as if in an arcade style format, its called button mashing! so when the game begins I used the followng routine and reccomend you try this too.   Position your fingers, hit space and start the game.  After the count down - begin to press the S key repeatedly (as fast as you can), once the Gnome is selected start pressing the SPACE BAR repeatedly and collect musrooms, once mushrooms are in the basket, start pressing the K key and once the Gnome has been selected immediatley start pressing SPACE BAR.  Now you will need to repeat this procedure throughout the game, this will allow you to get maximum hits without missing the time limit.  I found the X1 and X5 were Random so just stick to following the above procedure.  The reason this game is hard is because once you become distracted you will mess up, you might also start to feel sleepy - try not to look at your score in the top left as it can put you off.  Take full advantage of the breaks as they are essential to your FOCUS thru the game.  You will start to find the game difficult after your 2nd break - just remember to take big deep breathes thru your nose and out your mind to relax the mind so you remain focussed - just think of all that extra cash if you stay strong and remain focussed on this game.  I would also recommend you are not tired before playing as like me I nearly feel asleep and could feel my eyes rolling up! Also i wanted to highlight at the beginning be careful with the SPACE BAR - as you need to read the instructions carefully and I somehow hit the space bar twice and missed the very 1st screen
